title: Airy French Carnaroli Rice Mille Feuille
description: A rich and satisfying French dish featuring Carnaroli rice and double-rise bread, perfect for a quick and indulgent meal. This ayurvedic tamasic-friendly dish is sure to please.
instructions: Slice the double-rise bread into 1/4 inch thick slices.
Butter each slice of bread on both sides.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked Carnaroli rice, shredded gruyere cheese, and melted unsalted butter.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the beaten egg to the whipped cream and mix until well combined.
To assemble the mille feuille, place a slice of bread on a flat surface, followed by a layer of the rice mixture, and then a layer of the cream mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of bread on top.
Place the mille feuille in the oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
